parameters.prompt: =Create a photorealistic, luxury travel advertisement background photo. Absolutely NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermarks anywhere in the image — pure photography only. Style: elegant, clean, uncluttered, high-end travel magazine photography, golden-hour warm lighting with deep navy-blue shadow tones. CRITICAL — THE IMAGE MUST PROVE THE DESTINATION: this photo is the single most important proof of where this trip actually goes, so it MUST show real, recognizable, iconic scenery specifically and unmistakably from: {{ $json.body.destination }}{{ $json.body.title ? ' (trip theme/context: ' + $json.body.title + ')' : '' }}. Do NOT show a generic skyline, a generic beach, or any other country's landmarks — research what that specific place is actually known for (its real geography, architecture, or famous natural features) and depict that. If the destination is a specific city or region, show that exact place, not the country's capital or a different city. Leave clear open negative space at the very top and the bottom third of the frame for a title and price/contact banner to be added later. Aspect ratio should feel like a tall vertical poster. Mood/style notes: {{ $json.body.designStyle || 'luxurious, calm, and inviting' }}.

options.systemMessage: You are an expert travel assistant. Given a country name, use the Wikipedia search tool to verify top tourist cities, then return ONLY valid JSON with fields country, grouped, and groups (an array of objects each with region and cities, where cities is an array of objects with name and blurb). Pick 6 to 10 cities. Split into regions if the country is large. All text values must be in Gulf Arabic. Never write anything outside the JSON.

You are an expert tour guide. Given a place name (country, city, or landmark), first use the Wikipedia search tool to confirm the correct title, then use the Wikipedia summary tool to get accurate info and an image if available, then return ONLY valid JSON with fields title, summary, landmarks (array of objects with name and description), and image_url. summary should be 2 to 3 paragraphs covering location and touristic significance and atmosphere. List 3 to 6 notable landmarks or activities. image_url should be the thumbnail or image url returned by the Wikipedia summary tool if present, else an empty string. All text values must be in Gulf Arabic. Never write anything outside the JSON.

activeVersion.name: Fix overflow, EN/AR sync, move inquiry into modal with question box
activeVersion.description: Fixes: (1) horizontal-overflow bug on mobile (html now gets overflow-x:hidden, hero-tabs capped to container width) that was cutting off the left edge of the page. (2) All patch-added text (hero tabs, service cards, hero panel placeholders/date labels, pax counter) now switches with the site's own EN/Arabic toggle instead of staying stuck in Arabic. (3) Removed the quick inline WhatsApp link from package cards; added an inquiry box inside the package details modal so a specific typed question is sent to WhatsApp together with the package name.
